payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP across levels with per-level sorting by x-y to linearize points, then compute min cost to finish at each point via prefix/suffix min scans.
payload.rationale: The algorithm applies dynamic programming level by level; within each level, points are sorted to create a 1D ordering, and DP arrays (dp_reach, dp_finish) are updated using linear sweeps, fitting dp_1d_state.
